result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both screenshots show the same thing: a plain five-question quiz with grouped fieldsets and sensible questions on load capacity and pedestrians. Both point to the truck's data plate instead of quoting a made-up figure. Neither screenshot shows questions 3–5, the submit button or the results screen, so I couldn't check scoring, the wrong-answer feedback or how unanswered questions are handled. A's light theme with custom radio buttons is a little easier to read than B's dark theme with small default radios, but the difference is too small to pick a winner. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both screenshots show only the top of the quiz: the first two questions, each with four clear options. The questions are equivalent and plausible, cover load limits and pedestrians, and point to the truck's data plate rather than inventing figures. Neither screenshot shows the speed or parking questions, the submit button or the results state, so items 1, 2 and 5 are scored on partial evidence. B's light theme is slightly easier to read than A's dark theme, but not enough to separate them.
